name: Tallymite
description: Tallymite walks every surface it can reach, in order, once each, and marks off what it has covered. It has no interest in what any of it was, only in whether it has been there yet. Nothing it finds is ever kept. Everything it finds is written down.
babyDescription: Sets out along the edge of things and will not be turned around.
teenDescription: Has begun keeping count, and is very sure of the number.
adultDescription: Will finish the sweep. It has always finished the sweep.

history.change: palette: baseColor #7C8FC4 -> #8388BA, clearing latchback at dE00 8.7. W64-ROSTER wants dE00 >= 10 between any two species; this is the smallest move that clears 11 against all 31 others.

obtainRule: milestone-expeditions-8 — this species is EARNED rather than day-one. Gated as a whole crawler pair, never half of one: the two creatures in a pair are built to be read against each other, so gating one and not the other would hand a keeper half a joke. The rung is the expedition ladder’s own, so this arrives on a day a route already opens.
